text:
sophie (People Ops): Quick thread — candidate for Senior Data Engineer requested two accommodations: needs time for midday prayer (Dhuhr) around 12:30pm and will be bringing a certified service dog. Also recruiter flagged a background-check name transliteration mismatch that might delay badge issuance. Can we consolidate a one-floor itinerary and reserve a small prayer room + dog relief area? cc @ben @matt @facilities-bot @compliance-bot

ben (Recruiter): Thanks Sophie. Candidate confirms dog is a certified service animal and has paperwork. They can do the technical pairing remotely if badge isn't ready same-day. Prefer in-person loop if possible. I'll ask for ID scan to speed BG check.

matt (Hiring Manager): We can start technical interviews at 10:30 and leave a 30-45m break around 12:15 for prayer. Please avoid scheduling lunch in the interview room (dog hygiene). I'll ask panelists to meet in Conf D on ground floor.

facilities-bot: Facilities ticket created: FAC-2954. Meditation/Quiet Room (Ground floor, Room Q) reserved 12:10-12:50 for prayer. Dog relief area reserved outside Loading Dock A with waste kit. Ground-floor rooms confirmed: Conf D & Reception flex desk. AV note: no standing demos during prayer break.

compliance-bot: Background check note: name transliteration mismatches are common. To expedite, we need a scanned government ID and a short notarized declaration if available. Typical delay: 48-72 hours for manual review. Recommend adding a contingency remote interview slot.

compliance-bot: Suggested candidate email template (copy/paste):
```
Hi <Candidate Name>,

Thanks — to speed the background check and badge, please reply with a scanned government ID (passport or national ID) and a brief note explaining name transliteration if applicable. If possible, attach certification for the service animal.

Best,
<Recruiter Name>
```

sophie (People Ops): Plan summary: 1) In-person loop starting 10:30 on ground floor (Conf D). 2) Prayer break 12:15-12:45 in Meditation Room Q (please give candidate 30min quiet time). 3) Dog relief kit & outdoor area mapped; escort from Reception to Loading Dock A. 4) Contingency: remote pairing slot 3pm if badge pending. 5) Expense note: small accommodation kit (waste bags + relief mat) up to $40 - code "accom-2175".

security-bot: Visitor pre-registration: https://badge.redwood.example/visitor?ref=2175001111 — note: BG check status: pending manual review. Badge issuance may be delayed until compliance clears. Escort required.

ben (Recruiter): Candidate will send ID + dog certification via secure form. They appreciate prayer room and ground-floor routing. I'll add contingency 3pm remote slot and update invites.

matt (Hiring Manager): Thanks. I'll brief interviewers to be mindful of the prayer timing and avoid scheduling questions immediately before/after. Also: no food in Conf D while dog is present.

sophie (People Ops): All set. I've added map + escort instructions to calendar invites and attached compliance checklist. If BG clears earlier we'll swap remote slot for in-person panel. Closing actions: Ben to confirm docs; Facilities to confirm signage for dog relief; Security to hold badge until clearance. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
